title: Major Account Manager - Conglomerates
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Your Career**
 Working together with a Solutions Consultant,, you will be responsible for growing your territory. You are the primary point\-of\-contact for India’s one of the largest conglomerate group and are accountable for delivering above quota sales performance in your region. You are motivated by a hunger to solve critically difficult challenges that face our clients. You develop trusted relationships at a high, executive level, focusing on the strategic nature of the partnership. This means that you have a concrete understanding of our product suites, and are able to help identify areas that can be resolved by Palo Alto Networks solutions.
   

  

 You will lead to identifying and signing appropriate channel partners as well as training them on our solutions. Additionally, your credibility will guide your customers in their search to transition to a more secure online environment. You feel empowered by our product offerings \- and love a technical challenge.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* You will specifically be responsible for managing a strategic Conglomerate group
* Employing world\-class account management skills to identify cross\-selling and up\-selling opportunities within the target accounts
* Be a highly competent presenter, with a proven track record in selling to C level executives
* Develop and maintain detailed account profiles including organisational charts for all accounts to be reviewed by management on a quarterly basis
* Facilitate communication on strategic and tactical issues facing our clients and partners
* Maintain continuity and up\-to\-date knowledge of industry trends, technical developments, and governmental regulations that affect target markets
* Develop market strategies and goals for each product and service; understand the strategies, goals, and objectives of accounts
* Lead coordinating account strategy and tactics for sales support team (inside sales, systems engineering, sales management)
* Take full responsibility for accurate sales forecasting by demonstrating in\-depth knowledge of sales cycles from initial contact through the procurement process
* Extensive domestic travel and possible International travel as necessary


**Qualifications**
**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
 Prometteur is a leading global systems integrator and business transformation consulting organisation. Prometteur helps companies innovate and transform by leveraging its unique insights, differentiated services, and flexible partnering models. The company is among the Top mobile application development companies in India, and also a pioneer in web application development and Automation Testing. Prometteur has gained the trust of more than 300 offshore clients from 30\+ countries worldwide and has become a trustworthy software partner.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Develop and execute field sales activities to support business objectives.
* Identify new business opportunities and generate leads in the market
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and distributors.
* Conduct regular client visits, meetings, and product presentations.
* Achieve individual sales targets and contribute to overall team goals.
* Monitor sales activities and prepare regular sales reports.
* Coordinate with internal teams such as production, logistics, and marketing for smooth order execution.
* Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements.
* Ensure timely collection of payments from clients.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and sales activities.


**Qualifications**
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing products and processes.
* Ability to build client relationships and generate leads.
* Good presentation and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools (preferred).


 Additional Information
   

  

**Note** 
 : This is a 100% field\-sales role involving visiting customers/leads, pitching mobile/software services, and generating business. Candidates looking for inside sales, remote sales, or office\-based sales roles may not be suitable.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Hiwaga Makers is a 360° advertising and marketing agency that supports businesses with strategy, creative execution, and integrated media solutions across digital and traditional platforms. The team designs performance\-focused campaigns spanning marketing strategy, content and brand development, video production, social media management, influencer marketing, PR support, and OOH advertising. Based in Kottayam, Kerala, Hiwaga Makers has partnered with over 200 clients in healthcare, retail, hospitality, personal brands, education, and lifestyle sectors across 6 countries. The agency emphasizes structured, intentional marketing aligned with business goals, prioritizing clarity, systems, and long\-term partnerships over short\-term noise. Applicants joining Hiwaga Makers will work in an environment that treats marketing as a system built for sustainable growth and collaboration.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Business Development Manager is a full\-time hybrid role based in Kottayam, with flexibility for some work\-from\-home arrangements. This role is responsible for identifying and qualifying new business opportunities, nurturing leads, and building long\-term client relationships across multiple industries and markets. Day\-to\-day tasks include prospecting and outreach, conducting discovery meetings, preparing proposals and presentations, coordinating with internal strategy and creative teams, and managing the sales pipeline using CRM tools. The Business Development Manager will analyze market trends, collaborate on campaign pitches, negotiate contracts, and ensure smooth handover from closing deals to account management. The role also involves setting growth targets, tracking performance metrics, and representing Hiwaga Makers at events, online meetings, and partner engagements to drive structured, sustainable revenue growth.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Business development and sales skills, including prospecting, lead qualification, client relationship management, and deal negotiation.
* Marketing and advertising knowledge, with understanding of digital campaigns, social media, content marketing, and integrated media solutions.
* Strategic thinking and analytical skills to assess market opportunities, interpret campaign performance data, and align solutions with client business goals.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to conduct discovery calls, pitch proposals, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Organizational and planning abilities, including pipeline management, CRM usage, documentation, and time management in a fast\-paced environment.
* Relevant bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in an agency, media, or marketing services environment is preferred; familiarity with industries such as healthcare, retail, or hospitality is an advantage.
* Comfort working in a hybrid setup from Kottayam, with readiness for client meetings, occasional travel, and collaboration across remote and in\-office teams.

title: SAT Counsellor – International Sales (US Market)
description:
**About the Role** 




 As an SAT Counsellor, you'll own the full sales cycle for our SAT test\-prep offering in the US market — engaging prospective students and parents, understanding their college\-admissions goals, and consultatively closing them into the right program. This is a target\-driven, individual\-contributor closing role where your product knowledge, empathy and communication skills directly drive enrollments and revenue.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Engage prospective students and parents in the US market via calls, video counselling, instant messaging (WhatsApp) and other channels to sell ACE Academy's SAT test\-prep courses.
* Understand each student's college\-admissions goals, academic background and timeline, and recommend the most suitable SAT program through consultative selling.
* Own the complete sales funnel from lead qualification and product demonstration to closing, enrollment and post\-sale relationship.
* Drive conversions through effective follow\-ups, strong objection handling, and clear articulation of the value of our SAT prep.
* Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly enrollment and revenue targets.
* Handle high\-value / premium student profiles while maintaining an exceptional customer experience.
* Maintain accurate lead, activity and pipeline records in the CRM.
* Deliver a student\-first experience that generates referrals and repeat business.



  





**Requirements \& Qualifications** 



* 2–5 years of experience selling SAT / test\-prep or study\-abroad courses to US consumers (international EdTech sales strongly preferred).
* Bachelor's degree (graduation) in any discipline is required.
* Proven, documented track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth as an individual contributor.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication fluency is essential for engaging US students and parents.
* Strong understanding of the cultural nuances and buying behaviour of US\-based students and families.
* Ability to listen effectively, build trust, and approach prospects with patience and empathy.
* Proficiency with CRM tools / sales tracking software and basic MS Office.
* Familiarity with the SAT, US college\-admissions process, or the test\-prep industry is a strong added advantage.
* Comfortable working a 6\-day week on a US\-aligned night shift, including weekends.
* High\-energy, self\-motivated and results\-oriented, able to work fast and independently in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary plus uncapped performance\-based incentives.
* The chance to sell a Forbes\-recognised, globally trusted education brand.
* Warm, high\-intent leads from a large international market.
* WFH flexibility
